violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR under counter, right side Hot Box: chicken thighs were observed at 120-127f. Upon discussion with PIC, chicken thighs were received at proper temperature 30 minutes prior to inspection. Chicken thighs will only be served for lunch, a 3 hour period, and will be discarded afterwards.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS OBSERVED THE RECEIVING LOGS AND VERIFIED THE CHICKEN THIGHS WERE RECEIVED AT A PROPER TEMPERATURE. PIC WILL DISCARD THE CHICKEN THIGHS AFTER LUNCH SERVICE, 2.5 HOURS LATER, PER COMPANY POLICY.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed two boxes of chips and several boxes of single service utensils being stored directly on the floor of the dry storage/back storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD, UTENSILS, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS OFF OF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Observed ice machine not clean to sight and touch.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC cleaned ice machine during inspection.
